principle: Repetition is judged against real manufacture, installation and biology. Mass-produced construction may repeat when it would repeat in reality; natural growth, occupant behavior, weathering causality and large-area material phase may not collapse into conspicuous exact or perceptual near-clones.

approved_repetition.assembly: danchi exterior sash and balcony modules
approved_repetition.reason: Standardized public/suburban housing was intentionally modular and repeated bay construction is authentic.
approved_repetition.constraint: Exterior module repetition cannot be used as an excuse to repeat identical interior occupancy, weathering, reflection or texture phase.

approved_repetition.reason: Factory-made edging units legitimately repeat section and dimensions.
approved_repetition.constraint: Whole tree-pit ecology and understory layout must still respond to each anchor and pedestrian-pressure context.

approved_repetition.reason: Bolts, pipe sections and extrusion sections are manufactured components.
approved_repetition.constraint: Usage wear and material microstructure must remain physical and cannot become a repeated painted highlight.

prohibited_repetition: same 0-to-1 texture tile stretched independently across every broad ground surface
two or more generated natural tree masters with exact matching render-hierarchy geometry fingerprints
three or more exact-clone ecology patch render hierarchies
procedural natural assemblies made nominally unique only by tiny positional/rotational/scale jitter that is visually irrelevant at benchmark distance
all apartment windows showing the same curtain opening/material/room-value card
identical baked highlight, shadow or reflection marks repeated across modules
obvious repeated weathering stamp disconnected from drainage, grade splash, fixing or exposure cause

static_checks.rule: Grass, paving and compacted soil use metre-derived macro/detail scale and renderer-world phase rather than primitive 0..1 UV repetition.
static_checks.render_review_required: Inspect hero/ground_contact and grazing/tree_shadow_contact for visible tiling beats, especially across DanchiPlaza/ParkPath boundaries.

static_checks.rule: Thirty generated apartment bays require at least 18 unique LOD0 curtain signatures; an exact visible signature may occur no more than three times.
static_checks.render_review_required: Inspect hero/facade_center, hero/facade_right and oblique/balcony_services for cloned-window rhythm.

static_checks.rule: Every simultaneously active generated tree master must have a unique fine render-hierarchy fingerprint after root-space normalization.
static_checks.render_review_required: Inspect crown silhouettes from hero and oblique views; a numerically unique tree can still look perceptually cloned.

static_checks.rule: Six ecology patches require at least five unique fine render-hierarchy fingerprints and no exact fingerprint more than twice.
static_checks.render_review_required: Inspect vegetation_grounding and tree_shadow_contact crops for radial planting patterns or repeated understory clusters.

static_checks.rule: Natural tree masters and ecology patches are re-fingerprinted after generated numeric suffixes and sub-threshold transform differences are discarded. Tree masters require at least ceil(60 percent of active masters) coarse-unique signatures with no more than two coarse near-clones; six ecology patches require at least four coarse-unique signatures with no coarse signature occurring more than twice.
static_checks.reason: Tiny branch/leaf/understory jitter can defeat an exact hash without changing the silhouette or planting rhythm visible in a 4K benchmark. Static QA therefore rejects fake uniqueness before render review.
static_checks.render_review_required: Still inspect crown silhouettes and understory rhythm in native 4K. The coarse signature is intentionally conservative and cannot prove perceptual uniqueness.

fine.reason: Object indices and world positions must not create false uniqueness when internal geometry is actually cloned.

coarse.position: renderer centers normalized to each root's active-renderer span, quantized at 0.08
coarse.mesh_complexity: vertex count rounded to 16-vertex buckets plus submesh count
coarse.reason: The coarse pass intentionally ignores changes smaller than likely silhouette/planting-pattern significance so procedural jitter cannot masquerade as natural complexity.

render_review_required.decision: Static fine/coarse preflight can only reject implementation clone risk. It cannot award Visual Fidelity points or clear the critical repeated-pattern defect without actual Unity render evidence.

exclusions: Do not randomize authentic manufactured dimensions merely to create visual noise.
Do not hide repetition with blur, bloom, depth-of-field or sharpening artifacts.
